1.title: Red card system in disarray over Trump, Fifa and Balogun decision
1.summary: The decision to effectively overturn the red card shown to United States forward Folarin Balogun leaves many unanswered questions.

2.title: In Trump’s Second Midterm, Democrats Are Looking for Fighters
2.summary: Attitudes in the party have shifted, Democrats say, with a growing appetite for outsider candidates vowing to overhaul the system. Some worry that the trend could be costly in November.

3.title: Prosecutors to Detail Case Against Man Accused of Killing Charlie Kirk
3.summary: A judge will determine whether there is enough evidence to go to trial. Mr. Kirk’s widow and parents are expected to be in court.

4.title: Ukraine Rewrote Air Defense Tactics. Against Russia, It’s Still Not Enough.
4.summary: Ukraine has changed how militaries use Patriot systems. But recent attacks prove that clever adaptations cannot overcome a shortage of interceptors.

5.title: Deadly Russian Strikes Rock Kyiv on Eve of NATO Summit
5.summary: Ballistic missiles were fired into the capital of Ukraine as Russia launched its second major attack in less than a week. At least 12 people were killed, officials said.

6.title: Ukraine warns of interceptor missile shortage as 18 killed in Kyiv region
6.summary: President Zelensky says Sunday's "massive Russian attack" on Kyiv consisted of 68 missiles and 351 strike drones.
